comingLast.roast: level pegging with Whalan - the countback rules are being googled at the bar
Jones has never barracked so hard for another man's bogeys
all square with Jones at the bottom - somebody has to blink (or wipe)
in the clubhouse 3 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
his lead over Jones is 4 - a strong gust could move it
finished 6 above the blue line - toasting every point Jones does not score
in the clubhouse, 6 points of daylight, one nervous eye on the scorers
in on 7 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
